newsitem.title: USA: SITEL to buy Australian company.
newsitem.headline: SITEL to buy Australian company.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Tuesday it agreed to buy Levita Group Pty Ltd, a teleservices company based in Sydney, Australia, for about US$17 million to be paid principally in SITEL common stock.
Levita has annual revenues of about US$9 million. The transaction is expected to close in March.
Levita Group operates about 90 teleservicing positions and offers such telephone-based services as proxy solicitation and shareholder research for publicly traded companies.
SITEL provides outsourced telephone-based customer service and sales programs on behalf of large corporations worldwide.
